methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Knowledge Gateway is an internal SharePoint Online site (unitednations.sharepoint.com/sites/APP-Gateway) that serves as a central repository for UN system knowledge products, guidelines, and institutional documents.

## Authentication Challenge
SharePoint Online REST API (`/_api/`) returns HTTP 403 to all non-browser HTTP clients despite valid FedAuth session cookies. Azure Front Door (serving the `unitednations.sharepoint.com` tenant) enforces TLS/HTTP browser fingerprinting — Node.js `https` module produces a distinct JA3 fingerprint that is rejected.

Reproduction: Extract live FedAuth + rtFa cookies from an active authenticated Chrome session (including `msal.cache.encryption`, `spo_abt`, `SIMI`) and replay them via Axios with exact browser headers (`sec-fetch-site: same-origin`, `sec-ch-ua`, `Origin`, `Referer`). Result: still 403. Same cookies succeed in Chrome. Confirmed 2026-07-08.

## Access Strategy: Cache-File Mode
Since the browser's same-origin fetch context is always authenticated, we run a JavaScript snippet in Chrome DevTools console on the APP-Gateway page. The script uses the browser's own `fetch()` to call SharePoint REST API (`/_api/web/lists`, `/_api/web/lists(guid)/items`), then copies the full document listing JSON to clipboard. The result is saved to `api/data/kg-cache.json`.

The adapter reads from this cache file for all search and browse operations. Cache freshness is checked at read time — a warning is emitted if the cache is older than `maxFileAgeDays` (default 7).

## Browser Export Script
See `api/scripts/export-kg-docs.js` for the DevTools console snippet. To refresh:
1. Open Chrome and navigate to unitednations.sharepoint.com/sites/APP-Gateway (ensure logged in).
2. Open DevTools → Console tab.
3. Paste the export script and press Enter.
4. Wait for "Done! Copied N docs to clipboard".
5. Paste clipboard content into `api/data/kg-cache.json`.
6. Restart the API (or call the adapter's reload endpoint).

## Cache Structure
The cache JSON has the shape:
```json
{
  "libs": [{"id":"...","title":"Documents","count":N,"folder":"/sites/APP-Gateway/..."}],
  "docs": [{"title":"...","file":"doc.pdf","url":"https://unitednations.sharepoint.com/...","lib":"Documents","created":"...","modified":"...","id":"uuid"}],
  "at": "2026-07-08T..."
}
```

## Future: Bearer Token Mode
If a UN Azure AD service principal or MSAL device-code flow is configured, the adapter can switch to direct SharePoint REST API calls using `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The MSAL cache encryption key (`f7jsyk0p8FOSZS62VSHHzgVQFJ8UMxMjZ9dFAcFubFs`, id `019f1e0a-6abd-793d-b27a-b6266af1d150`) was recovered from the `msal.cache.encryption` browser cookie during the 2026-07-08 investigation — decrypting the MSAL localStorage blob would yield a valid access token. Toggle via `config.useApi=true` once token flow is implemented.

## Limitations
- Cache refresh is manual (weekly recommended).
- Download requires authenticated browser session — `pdfUrl` is null; `url` opens the document in SharePoint.
- No full-text indexing; search is over title and filename only.
- Library structure varies — run cache export to discover available libraries.
